label: Crème Chantilly
note: Whipped cream sweetened with sugar and usually flavoured with vanilla

about.text: Whipped cream sweetened with sugar and usually flavoured with vanilla. Its invention is often credited to François Vatel, steward of the Château de Chantilly in the 1660s, which gave it its name.
